exposure: Planned caesarean vs. unplanned caesarean vs. vaginal birth
finding: Children born through caesarean section had a twofold increased odds of being overweight, obese, or overweight/obese at 8 years of age compared to those born vaginally, regardless of whether the caesarean was planned or unplanned.
mod_finding: Children born through both planned and unplanned caesarean section had similar increased odds of being overweight/obese at age 8 compared to those born vaginally.
